# Smart Device Platform — Agent Guide

Short entry point for coding agents. Use this file for start-up discipline only; detailed rules live in [`harness/`](harness/), project navigation lives in [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md).

## Project Overview

Flutter monorepo for smart-device Apps (glasses, watches, earphones). Priority is establishing platform specs and reusable capabilities first, then incrementally delivering features and Apps.

```text
apps/              App shells, brand and App-specific logic
packages/widget/   Composite pages/components using Feature state (may depend on Feature)
packages/feature/  Complete user scenarios, grouped by domain (device/, ai/, …)
packages/common/   Shared primitives below Feature (no Feature deps)
packages/core/     Base types and cross-App/cross-platform capabilities
specs/             Capability contracts
```

Dependency direction: `App → Widget → Feature → Common → Core`. Full layer model: [`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md#layer-structure).

## Fact Priority

When conflicts arise, follow the authority order in [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md#fact-priority): code and `pubspec.yaml` first, then stable specs, then active architecture docs and ADRs, then draft/planning assets.

`app_configs/` is planning-only and does not participate in the build. `generate_app.dart` is not implemented — do not describe future generation as a current capability.

## Engineering Rules

Read these by intent, not all upfront:

| Need | Source |
|---|---|
| Hard constraints, package boundaries, doc sync | [`harness/rules.md`](harness/rules.md) |
| Step-by-step task flow | [`harness/checklists.md`](harness/checklists.md) |
| Commands and verification scope | [`harness/commands.md`](harness/commands.md) |
| Project workflow Skills | [`skills/INDEX.md`](skills/INDEX.md) |
| Known BLE / Audio / Riverpod / Navigation traps | [`harness/pitfalls.md`](harness/pitfalls.md) |
| Architecture decisions | [`docs/decisions/`](docs/decisions/README.md) |

## Task Navigation

For the full task map, use [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md#navigation-by-task). Common agent routes:

| Task | Start with |
|---|---|
| Choose where a change belongs | `docs/architecture.md` |
| New platform capability / Core package | `specs/README.md`, relevant capability spec, `docs/decisions/0002-graded-core-first.md` |
| New Feature / Common / Widget package | `docs/architecture.md`, `harness/rules.md`, then `harness/checklists.md` |
| New App | `docs/app-dev-runbook.md` |
| Implement or redesign a UI page | `skills/ui-page-implementation/SKILL.md` → `docs/ui-page-workflow.md` |
| Cross-module or multi-session work | `skills/plan-lifecycle/SKILL.md` → `docs/plans/README.md` |
| Existing Provider / API lookup | `docs/implementation-status.md` → Provider Quick Reference |
| Native SDK / protocol / transmission | `native_app/inventory/README.md`, `SDK/index.md`, owning capability Spec |

## Work and Verification

1. Before implementing complex work, use [`plan-lifecycle`](skills/plan-lifecycle/SKILL.md) to select or create one current active Plan.
2. At close-out, use the relevant checklist or Skill and apply only matching rows from the [`Doc Sync Matrix`](harness/rules.md#doc-sync-matrix).
3. Select verification from [`harness/commands.md`](harness/commands.md#command-selection) and report exactly what was not run. Do not describe untested builds, simulator runs, or device runs as passing.

</INSTRUCTIONS>
我会只读核对原生设置页、双端 SDK 封装和库存文档，区分“Flutter 尚未接入”与“SDK/协议本身没有可实现合同”的缺口。
现有规范已把几项明确标为“无 getter / 无型号映射 / 无内核字段”。我接着回到 iOS 与 Android 源码找调用点，避免把 Flutter 侧的暂时未接入误报成 SDK 缺口。
原生端的差异已很清楚：旧 iOS App 直接走旧 `commonApp` 的内核版本和媒体比例请求，而当前 VK 1.6 公共 settings 接口只提供写入类操作。再核对身份快照和解绑语义后，我会给出可直接放入 SDK 缺失清单的结论。

只读审计结论：

- `SDK-014` 按键定义仍 blocked：当前 iOS `AkKeyType` / `BkKeyType` 都只有 `unknown`，虽有 `setKeyConfig`，但无法生成型号化按键选项或保证功能码正确。[AK 接口](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/SDK/IOS/sdk/xcframework/VKBLEAKWGlasses.xcframework/ios-arm64/VKBLEAKWGlasses.framework/Modules/VKBLEAKWGlasses.swiftmodule/arm64-apple-ios.swiftinterface:236>)、[BK 接口](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/SDK/IOS/sdk/xcframework/VKBLEBKGlasses.xcframework/ios-arm64/VKBLEBKGlasses.framework/Modules/VKBLEBKGlasses.swiftmodule/arm64-apple-ios.swiftinterface:303>)。原生按键页依赖服务端 `buttonFunctionV2(deviceCode)` 模型，[iOS service](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Module/MyDevice/SmartGlasses/Setting/Details/Service/WKSmartGlassesKeyDefineService.swift:223>)。SDK 需补型号、按键/手势、功能码、默认值、读回和错误合同。

- 照片比例是 SDK/protocol 缺口：原生通过旧 raw 协议查询支持集并写入照片比例，[查询/解析](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Component/BLE/WKPeripherals/Apps/BKSmartGlasses/SetApp/WKSmartGlassesSetApp.swift:74>)、[写入](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Component/BLE/WKPeripherals/Apps/BKSmartGlasses/SetApp/WKSmartGlassesSetApp.swift:114>)；VK 1.6 public settings service 没有 media-scale query/set API。[AK service](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/SDK/IOS/sdk/xcframework/VKBLEAKWGlasses.xcframework/ios-arm64/VKBLEAKWGlasses.framework/Modules/VKBLEAKWGlasses.swiftmodule/arm64-apple-ios.swiftinterface:390>)。需双端 typed 查询、支持项、写入 ACK/状态和机型矩阵。

- 语音唤醒、霍尔开关缺真实读取合同：新 SDK 只有 `setVoiceWakeup`，AK 只有 `setHallSwitch`，没有对应 getter 或状态流；BK 也无霍尔接口。[AK](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/SDK/IOS/sdk/xcframework/VKBLEAKWGlasses.xcframework/ios-arm64/VKBLEAKWGlasses.framework/Modules/VKBLEAKWGlasses.swiftmodule/arm64-apple-ios.swiftinterface:395>)、[BK](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/SDK/IOS/sdk/xcframework/VKBLEBKGlasses.xcframework/ios-arm64/VKBLEBKGlasses.framework/Modules/VKBLEBKGlasses.swiftmodule/arm64-apple-ios.swiftinterface:445>)。旧 iOS 依赖本地配置和通知，不是可迁移的 SDK state source。

- 内核版本缺当前 SDK 合同：旧 iOS raw 路径可请求 `requestDeviceFrameworkVersion`，[调用](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Module/MyDevice/Controller/DeviceInfo/WKDeviceInfoProvider.swift:48>)；当前 `VKBLEDeviceInfo` 没有等价内核版本字段，[公开字段](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/SDK/IOS/sdk/xcframework/VKBLECore.xcframework/ios-arm64/VKBLECore.framework/Modules/VKBLECore.swiftmodule/arm64-apple-ios.swiftinterface:2132>)。需要公开 typed query/result，而非复用 `bandVersionCode`。

- `supports=260` 不是 SDK AAR 缺口，而是后端设备身份合同缺口：原生把 `260` 解析为 AP，[映射](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Module/MyDevice/Model/SCDeviceSupportFunctionModel.m:743>)，再决定 BK AP/Wi-Fi，[分流](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Module/MyDevice/Model/Extension/HTHDeviceModel+WK.swift:23>)。后端必须稳定返回并持久化该字段；缺失时保持未知。

- 视频防抖、2K/4K 不应列为设备 SDK 缺失。防抖是 iOS App 本地视频编辑流水线偏好，[UserDefaults 开关](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Module/MyDevice/SmartGlasses/Home/WKVideoEditor/WKVideoStabilization/WKVideoStabilizationManager.swift:31>)；2K/4K 实际切换本地 FFmpeg 补帧，[选择逻辑](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Module/MyDevice/SmartGlasses/Setting/Details/ViewController/WKSmartGlassesMultimediaSettingsViewController.swift:122>)。它们是 Flutter 媒体处理能力缺口，不是 BLE 设置能力。

- 恢复出厂命令本身已有：规范确认 Android `resetBand()` / iOS `factoryReset()`，[spec](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/specs/capabilities/device_settings.md:27>)。仍缺真机的设备清空/断连/ACK 时序证据；统一设备本地清理应由 App 解绑流程承担。原 Android 仅在恢复出厂前清了 App LLM 缓存，[原生](</Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/WearfitPro-feat-sdk-glass_sdk_merge_20260521_16kb/feature-glasses/src/main/java/com/wakeup/module/glasses/activity/settings/GlassesSettingsActivity.kt:245>)，不能作为全量清理依据。

未修改任何文件。
